Players Committee card image of [[Maneuvering Flaps (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to take its matching pilot character (or vice versa) into hand from Reserve Deck and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. May not be suspended (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/maneuveringflaps.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
